summary: Agar.io entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Agar.io

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Desktop browser capture at native monitor resolution

primary.why: Agar.io originated as a browser game and later received Android and iOS apps. The browser route keeps the original PC/mouse control context and clean desktop capture; mobile apps are useful alternates but not sourced as exclusive-content routes.
primary.how_to_play: Play at agar.io in a desktop browser with a stable connection. Record date/server mode because this is an online multiplayer game whose modes and monetization can change.

all_releases.fidelity: Original platform family, mouse/keyboard control, clean desktop capture.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity to the original browser-game context and strongest recording path.

all_releases.fidelity: Touchscreen mobile port with mobile-specific controls.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive content over browser route; use only for mobile-control comparison.
